actions.label: Learning Memory
actions.description: Review what Buddy tried, what worked, what failed and the evidence behind each lesson.

actions.label: Reuse Lessons
actions.description: Feed prior lessons into future remediation so Buddy does not repeatedly make the same learning mistake.

actions.label: Regression Watch
actions.description: Detect when a previously strong capability falls below its promotion threshold.

actions.label: Compare Attempts
actions.description: Compare strategies by measurable improvement, speed, cost and reliability.

actions.label: Promote Evidence
actions.description: Promote only repeatable, benchmarked improvements into the trusted capability ledger.
